summary: Cycles 1231/1232/1234: git worktree add -B cycle-… rc=255 (transient contention on the shared .git — the runtime plane is a LINKED WORKTREE of the console repo, so console git activity and N lanes' provisioning all take the same locks). Provisioning fails once -> ActiveWorktree empty -> CB.2 correctly fail-fasts every subsequent dispatch exit=10 -> identical fingerprints -> breaker halt. The alarm chain is CORRECT end-to-end; the missing piece is that Create treats a transient lock failure as permanent. Fix shape (verifylock precedent): bounded retry-with-backoff around o.worktree.Create (e.g. 3 attempts, 2s/4s), treating rc=255-with-empty-stderr as retryable; on final failure keep today's WARN+fail-fast. ALSO the fingerprint should carry the PROVISIONING error, not the downstream scout refusal — the 3 dossiers fingerprinted the alarm (scout|infra-error) instead of the cause, which cost one wrong fix (PR #400, adversarially refuted) before the WARN was read. OPERATOR half, already in force: no console git churn in the shared repo while a batch runs (live_loop_console_dev_worktree_only).
title: worktree.Create has no retry — one transient git-lock collision on the shared .git kills a lane's whole cycle (and 3 identical ones halt the batch)
